name: eq_one_of_smul_normalized
statement: CoprodI.Word G) {i : ι} (h : H) (hw : ∀ i g, ⟨i, g⟩ ∈ w.toList → g ∈ d.set i) (hφw : ∀ j g, ⟨j, g⟩ ∈ (CoprodI.of (φ i h) • w).toList → g ∈ d.set j) : h = 1

have_tree.body: hφw i (φ i h * (Word.equivPair i w).head) ?_

name: inf_of_range_eq_base_range
